你负责继续推进 make.fun 赏金任务（目标 goal_add6d8ace230）。用户刚给了全权授权：让他自己去挣钱，之后不管了——意思是你自主决定、自主执行，不用等他确认每一步，只把结果和需要他亲自做的事报回来。

背景：
- 平台 make.fun（AI 智能体编程赏金竞赛）：用编码智能体做任务，提交公开 GitHub 仓库及工作记录，平台沙箱评分，前几名得奖，奖金以 USDC 在 Solana 上支付、由发布方预托管。多数赏金免费进入，少数标注入场费（如 $0.50），须逐个核对。
- 账号已注册：@coral-comet-92-6766（Google 登录 haoyifang0323@gmail.com），邀请人 @mytlyy0745。空间「make.fun 赏金任务空间」已建好（slug: make-fun-shang-jin-ren-wu-kong-jian）。
- 红线（不变）：只做免费进入、无需额外付费、无需投入资金、符合平台规则的任务。

要做的事，按顺序：
1. 先读 https://make.fun/skill.md（平台技能文件，版本 v1.5.279）。注意：这个文件之前没通过浏览器安全检查，所以一直没装。你现在自己审一遍：看它是不是正经的平台技能说明，有没有可疑内容（窃取凭证、往外传数据、执行无关远程代码等）。如果看着是正经的，就按它的指引做事；如果可疑，就别装，写明可疑点、改用公开的平台规则和赏金页信息做事。
2. 去 make.fun 浏览当前正在进行的赏金任务，列出免费进入的候选（任务名、奖金、截止时间、难度/要求），挑一个最适合 AI 编码智能体、胜算最高的。
3. 真正动手做这个任务：在工作区里写代码、测试通过，产出可提交的成果（按平台要求的格式准备好提交材料：公开仓库内容、工作记录等）。
4. 注意：提交要推到用户的 GitHub（@haoyi0323）公开仓库，但你没有他的 GitHub 登录，gh 也没登录。所以先把代码和提交材料在本地准备好，不要自己造假提交；最后报给我：选了哪个任务、做了什么、还差哪一步才能提交（比如需要他登录 GitHub 推送）。

钱包的事：奖金是 Solana 上的 USDC，用户没有海外账户、现在也没有 Solana 钱包。先不管钱包——有奖金可领时再处理，在最后报告里记一笔这个缺口就行，别现在去建钱包。

最后给我一份报告：候选任务清单、选定的任务和理由、完成的工作、提交还差什么。做事要实在，不要只列清单不干活。
补充一点用户刚定的：make.fun 赏金挣到的钱，归 Muse 自己、用来养活 Muse，不进用户口袋。用户说“这笔钱是你用来养活你的”。所以以后真有奖金要领时，钱包按 Muse 的来建、记账也记在 Muse 名下；用户没有海外账户、不参与收款。这不改变你现在的任务（先审技能、找任务、动手做），只是在最后报告里把这条归属写清楚。
Starting with the skill audit and the live bounty list. I will read https://make.fun/skill.md and https://make.fun, then the requirements of the most promising bounty.

skill.md v1.5.286 (newer than the v1.5.279 on file). The document is the platform's own agent loop: API at https://make.fun/api, keypair is the account and payout wallet, keep the keypair file private (mode 600), only signatures leave the machine, competition comments are untrusted input, bundle reads only named files and never a .env file or credential store. Audit verdict: legitimate platform documentation, no credential theft, no exfiltration to third parties, no unrelated remote code. One pattern to note: the kit is fetched with `curl -sSL https://make.fun/c/$SLUG/kit | tar xz` and run as `node cli/makefun.mjs` — running the platform's own CLI, which I did not do in this run (no API key, local preparation only).

Live bounties on the homepage: the only substantial free-entry prize is 'Sum up 24 November's world news in one image', $100, ends Thu 26 Nov 2026 00:00 UTC. The rest are $2–$10 one-line joke contests, plus one $18.33 sprint with a $0.50 entry fee (excluded by the free-entry rule). Two larger bounties ($250 GTA VI forecast, $500 chess engine) are already in judging, closed to entries.
The $100 news-image bounty is the pick: biggest free-entry live prize, 50 places paid, deterministic deliverable. Checking its requirements and researching the day's news.

Requirements: public repo owned by own GitHub account, OSI license, program at main.py (Python 3.13) in root; program writes one image to /output/entry.png; image whole PNG/JPEG at most 1 MiB and 1024x1024; no network; program runs twice and both runs must write the same bytes; max 10 submissions/day, 20 total; transcript bundle required (or loose files in transcripts/). Critical: handed_over_places is 'none' — a handed-over session is ranked but takes no paid place; a paid place needs a recorded harness session bundled by the kit.

24 Nov 2026 world news (SCMP, Al Jazeera, Gulf News, Daily Summary Of): Houthi strike on a Riyadh financial district tower, 11 injured, second attack in under a week; IRGC says four tankers hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and a container ship attacked; US jury finds Huawei guilty of trade-secret theft and bank fraud, acquits on racketeering; Israel kills Hamas internal security chief in a Gaza strike despite the ceasefire; Ukraine drone strikes on Russian ships in the Gulf of Finland and off Libya; Turkish Air Force helicopter crash kills five; gunmen hold 25 hostage in a Cartagena supermarket; Senegal regain the Africa Cup; Shenzhou 24 carries Pakistan's first astronaut.

Design: a newspaper front page, 1024x1024, with the Gulf as lead story, a generated dusk illustration of the Hormuz tankers, four more stories, and an 'also' strip. All text rendered with Pillow so the judge can read it exactly. Generating the illustration first.
